propositions: JSON files index.json and criterion-pins.json lack self-identifying markers despite being derived, requiring a _generated_by top-level key to prevent edits to the generated artifact instead of its source

Plans and maintainers cannot locate all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces in one place, forcing discovery via domain knowledge rather than documentation, increasing risk of marking hand-authored surfaces incorrectly
Markers must be fixed points — regeneration must reproduce them byte-for-byte — so the drift gate stays green and accidental marker loss during regeneration is caught

Two existing on-disk equality tests (test_index_on_disk_matches_regenerated and test_user_write_does_not_change_committed_index) must be re-pointed to compare against build_index_document() rather than the pure builder, since the committed file will carry the marker

A docs/README.md table must enumerate all derived surfaces with their regenerate commands and enforcing gates, and explicitly flag three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces to prevent incorrect bannering
